notes.title: Now playable with HTC Vive
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/qQ8aLJN.jpg[/img]

Hi guys :) We are happy to announce our very first build with HTC Vive support :) Hope you will enjoy InMind's world by taking a walk inside the scientific cockpit inside the human brain.

The game will auto detect plugged VR device and run on it, but if you are the luckiest man in the world and own HTC Vive and Oculus Rift and they are simultaneously plugged in one PC just use launch arguments as:
[list] 
 [*]"InMind.exe -vrmode oculus"
 [*]"InMind.exe -vrmode vive"
 [*]"InMind.exe -vrmode none" (just regular mode without VR)
[/list]

Thank you :)

notes.title: Oculus Runtime 0.8, Unity 5.3 and Mobile VR
notes.content:
Hi :) Both our games InMind and InCell were updated to Unity 5.3 with Oculus 0.8 support. Now 0.8+ is required to play with Oculus VR.

Also we are proud to announce that mobile versions of InCell & InMind are now available for iOS/Android/Windows Phone and Samsung Gear VR. 
[list]
[*]http://incell.nivalvr.com
[*]http://inmind.nivalvr.com
[/list]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/396030

notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/396030

Hi :) We are proud to show you our new game (as an evolution of our InMind idea) - InCell VR.

This InMind update contains:
[list][*]Upgraded to Unity 5
[*]Oculus Runtime 0.6 & 0.7 support added
[*]Linux stability improved[/list]

notes.title: Some fixes are released
notes.content:
Thank you for checking out our small VR experience :)
We are so sorry for technical problems, here are some fixes in version 0.0.7.1:
[list]
[*]Mac Retina window size fixed
[*]Invalid score bug fixed
[*]Alert about not compatible Oculus software added
[*]Stability fixes (crashes and stucks on Windows)
[*]Other small fixes and improvement
[/list]

If you still have problems feel free to mail us (info at nivalvr dot com) post comment on the [url=facebook.com/nivalvr]facebook[/url] or [url=twitter.com/nivalvr]write a twit[/url]. We are ready to help with your problems personaly (chat/skype/etc.).

Thank you :)
